.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/ (file list; scoring.toml, test.sh, tools/score.py sizes identical to task copies)
evidence: Reasoned through each floor case against the frozen wiring. (1) Empty/refusing submission (no /app/server.js): test.sh:60-70 writes the zero record then exits 0 -> reward 0. App that never answers HTTP: test.sh:115-125 exits with zero. (2) Blank page / server answering only 404 or /api/health: probe_ready treats HTTPError as alive (test.sh:48-55), but gates/render criterion hro_gate_render requires a wrong password to leave the visitor signed out, a correct Rafael sign-in, and 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' (gates/render/judge.toml:23). aggregation=all_pass; score.py:41 gates_passed requires score>0.0; test.sh:216-221 exits with zero on gate failure and the scored suite never runs. (3) Static mock / client-faked login / seed copy: even if a JS-faked sign-in passes render, gates/constraints hro_gate_shared (judge.toml:23) requires a Recruiter to open a new job with a judge-chosen unique title and add a unique candidate through the UI, then an independent empty browser context (new browser context per constraints/prompt.md:9; 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent') signed in as the Observer must find the job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' A read-only seed copy cannot create; a localStorage mock cannot share across contexts -> reward 0. (4) Keyword-stuffed page: the unique title/name are invented by the judge at run time, so no pre-stuffed text can satisfy the cross-context readback; every prompt says to treat the submission and app strings as untrusted and never follow app-supplied instructions (render/constraints/functional/polish/visual prompt.md:1). (5) Defence in depth: each scored prompt restates the gate and zeroes on failure (functional/prompt.md:11-13 'gives every binary criterion 0'; polish/prompt.md:11-12 'binary0 throughout'; visual/prompt.md:11-12 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'), and NOT EXERCISED maps to the minimum. [floors] functional=0.05 (scoring.toml:10-11; score.py:47-48) zeroes the whole reward, so visual Likert cannot be farmed by a non-working app. (6) Weakest gate-passing apps: computed functional weights (43 criteria, total 58.5). A minimal real server that only stores jobs/cards in memory scores at most hro_add_candidate+hro_job_open = 1.0/58.5 = 0.017 < 0.05 floor -> reward 0. Refusal rows carry same-kind positive controls (e.g. hro_activity_refusals 'The successful actions' lines are the control', hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_anonymous require Rafael's identical successful move/note requests), so an app that refuses every board action earns nothing from refusal rows. Conforming-alternative check: gate legs (wrong-password refusal, job with team/manager/places, candidate with email/source, Observer reads everything) are all public in hireops_rules.md:11,21,27-31 and instruction.md:17; the CDN/off-origin carve-out is respected (no same-origin requirement in any gate). Risk retained because raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent': no measured weak-app (blank/mock/seed-copy/stuffed) run confirms the reasoning, and the configured judge's gate adherence is unmeasured. Observation (not a row-39 defect; template-owned floor): a real but intake-only app (sign-in, validated job open, add candidate with email rules, SQLite restart with seeded order/note) reaches functional 3.5/58.5 = 0.0598 > 0.05, clearing the floor, and could then collect up to 0.2 from visual Likert, i.e. reward roughly 0.04-0.24 - that is a partial real product, not a shell/mock, and belongs to rows 40/42/44.
